title: Norwegian Crumble Tacos
description: A twist on traditional tacos, this recipe combines the flavors of Norway with the heart of Mexican cuisine.
instructions: Cook ground beef in a skillet until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add taco seasoning to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, mix together zesty norwegian cheese, crumbly crackers, oat flour, and crumble butter.
Add the cheese mixture to the skillet with the ground beef and stir to combine.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by spooning the beef mixture onto a tortilla and topping with sour cream, cumin, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
